file.title: Open saved session?
file.description: Brings back 3 runs with their names and pins and the comparison. Replaces the current inputs; input undo starts at the opened session.

fileOverRuns.title: Open saved session?
fileOverRuns.description: Brings back 3 runs with their names and pins and the comparison. Replaces the current inputs and 2 runs in this tab; input undo starts at the opened session. Save session first to keep the current runs.
